-- What a client importing `Proof.go_etcd_io.raft.v3.MemstorageInstance` sees of it (generated by etc/gen-interface.py; do not edit).
-- Every declaration also takes the ambient section variables (left out below): the Go semantics
-- (`ext`, `ffi`, `go_gctx`, `sem`, the package's `Assumptions`), `GF`, `hG`, `StorageModel GF`, `AllG GF`.

theorem memStorCap_intro [MemStorReg GF] (ms : Loc) (γs : MemStorNames) (k : Int) (h : γs.cap ≤ k) :
    ⊢ memStorReg ms γs -∗ storCap (memStorIface ms) k

theorem memStorage_Append [package_sem : Assumptions] [MemStorReg GF] (ms : Loc) (γs : MemStorNames)
    (p : List EntryM) (s : GoSlice) (dq : DFrac) (Hfit : ∀ (e0 : EntryM), p.head? = some e0 → uint.Z
    e0.Index' + ↑p.length ≤ 2 ^ 61) : ⊢ ∀ Φ, isPkgInit pkg_id.go_etcd_io.raft.v3 ∗ memStorReg ms γs
    ∗ appendRight (memStorIface ms) p ∗ entsPts s dq p -∗ ▷ (appendReceipt (memStorIface ms) p ∗
    entsPts s dq p -∗ Φ (intoVal GoInterface.nil)) -∗ WP ((intoVal (methods
    MemoryStorage.ty.PointerType [65#8, 112#8, 112#8, 101#8, 110#8, 100#8] (intoVal ms))) (intoVal
    s)) {{ Φ }}

def memStorAppendTok [MemStorReg GF] (st : Storage) (σ : StorState) (p : List EntryM) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ ms γs, ⌜st = memStorIface ms⌝ ∗ memStorReg ms γs ∗ memAppendTok ms γs σ p)

def memStorCapI [MemStorReg GF] (st : Storage) (k : Int) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ ms γs, ⌜st = memStorIface ms⌝ ∗ memStorReg ms γs ∗ ⌜γs.cap ≤ k⌝)

theorem memStorCert_at [MemStorReg GF] (ms : Loc) (γs : MemStorNames) (k : SnapTrip) : ⊢ memStorReg
    ms γs -∗ storCert (memStorIface ms) k -∗ memStorCert γs k

theorem memAppendRight_at [package_sem : Assumptions] [MemStorReg GF] (ms : Loc) (γs : MemStorNames)
    (p : List EntryM) : ⊢ memStorReg ms γs -∗ appendRight (memStorIface ms) p -∗ ⌜p = []⌝ ∨ ∃ σ,
    memAppendTok ms γs σ p

theorem memStorReg_agree [MemStorReg GF] (ms : Loc) (γs1 γs2 : MemStorNames) : ⊢ memStorReg ms γs1
    -∗ memStorReg ms γs2 -∗ ⌜γs1 = γs2⌝

def memStorRegAuth [MemStorReg GF] (M : GMap Loc MemStorNamesRec) : IProp GF :=
  ghostMapAuth (MemStorReg.memStorRegName GF) 1 M

structure MemStorReg.{u_1, u_2, u_3} (GF : BundledGFunctors) : Type where
  memStorRegName : GName

def memStorReg [MemStorReg GF] (ms : Loc) (γs : MemStorNames) : IProp GF :=
  ms ↪[MemStorReg.memStorRegName GF]□ γs.tuple

theorem memStorReg_persistent [MemStorReg GF] (ms : Loc) (γs : MemStorNames) : Persistent
    (memStorReg ms γs)

theorem memStorCut_capI [MemStorReg GF] (st : Storage) (n k : Int) : memStorCutI st n ∗ memStorCapI
    st k ⊢ ⌜n ≤ k⌝

def memOwnStorage [MemStorReg GF] (st : Storage) (σ : StorState) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ ms γs,
      ⌜st = memStorIface ms⌝ ∗
        memStorReg ms γs ∗ ownMemoryStorage ms γs σ ∗ ⌜σ.prev.index' ≠ W64 0 → σ.ss.index' ≠ W64 0⌝)

theorem memStorCertOk_intro [package_sem : Assumptions] [MemStorReg GF] (γ : RaftNames) (ms : Loc)
    (γs : MemStorNames) : ⊢ memCertInv γ γs -∗ memStorReg ms γs -∗ storCertOk γ (memStorIface ms)

theorem memStorAppendedTok_intro [package_sem : Assumptions] [MemStorReg GF] (ms : Loc) (γs :
    MemStorNames) (σ : StorState) (p : List EntryM) : ⊢ memStorReg ms γs -∗ memAppendedTok ms γs σ p
    -∗ appendedTok (memStorIface ms) σ p

def memStorageModel [MemStorReg GF] : StorageModel GF :=
  { ownStorage := memOwnStorage, appendTok := memStorAppendTok, appendedTok := memStorAppendedTok, storCut := memStorCutI,
    storCut_persistent := ⋯, storFloor := memStorFloorI, storFloor_persistent := ⋯, storCap := memStorCapI,
    storCap_persistent := ⋯, storCut_cap := ⋯, storCert := memStorCertI, storCert_persistent := ⋯ }

theorem memStorFloor_at [package_sem : Assumptions] [MemStorReg GF] (ms : Loc) (γs : MemStorNames)
    (x : w64) : ⊢ memStorReg ms γs -∗ storFloor (memStorIface ms) x -∗ memFloorTok ms γs x

theorem MemStorNames.rec_inj (γs1 γs2 : MemStorNames) (h : γs1.tuple = γs2.tuple) : γs1 = γs2

theorem memStorCert_intro [MemStorReg GF] (ms : Loc) (γs : MemStorNames) (k : SnapTrip) : ⊢
    memStorReg ms γs -∗ memStorCert γs k -∗ storCert (memStorIface ms) k

def memStorCutI [MemStorReg GF] (st : Storage) (n : Int) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ ms γs, ⌜st = memStorIface ms⌝ ∗ memStorReg ms γs ∗ memStorCut γs n)

theorem memStorIface_inj [MemStorReg GF] (ms1 ms2 : Loc) : memStorIface ms1 = memStorIface ms2 → ms1
    = ms2

def MemStorNamesRec : Type :=
  GName × GName × GName × GName × GName × GName × GName × GName × GName × GName × Int × GName

def memStorCertI [MemStorReg GF] (st : Storage) (k : SnapTrip) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ ms γs, ⌜st = memStorIface ms⌝ ∗ memStorReg ms γs ∗ memStorCert γs k)

theorem memStorAppendTok_at [package_sem : Assumptions] [MemStorReg GF] (ms : Loc) (γs :
    MemStorNames) (σ : StorState) (p : List EntryM) : ⊢ memStorReg ms γs -∗ appendTok (memStorIface
    ms) σ p -∗ memAppendTok ms γs σ p

def memStorIface (ms : Loc) : Storage :=
  interface.mkOk MemoryStorage.ty.PointerType (intoVal ms)

def memStorFloorI [MemStorReg GF] (st : Storage) (x : w64) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ ms γs, ⌜st = memStorIface ms⌝ ∗ memStorReg ms γs ∗ memFloorTok ms γs x)

theorem memAppendReceipt_intro [package_sem : Assumptions] [MemStorReg GF] (ms : Loc) (γs :
    MemStorNames) (p : List EntryM) : ⊢ memStorReg ms γs -∗ (⌜p = []⌝ ∨ ∃ σ, memAppendedTok ms γs σ
    p) -∗ appendReceipt (memStorIface ms) p

def MemStorNames.tuple (γs : MemStorNames) : MemStorNamesRec :=
  (γs.hist, γs.done, γs.ep, γs.sn, γs.sw, γs.lk, γs.ok, γs.ak, γs.cb, γs.bd, γs.cap, γs.cert)

def memStorAppendedTok [MemStorReg GF] (st : Storage) (σ : StorState) (p : List EntryM) : IProp GF
    :=
  iprop(∃ ms γs, ⌜st = memStorIface ms⌝ ∗ memStorReg ms γs ∗ memAppendedTok ms γs σ p)
